snippet.title: Moment to Midnight: An unorthodox little narrative game
snippet.description:
Moment to Midnight is a small narrative game made in a week, inspired by Ludum Dare 45, with a lot of optional dialogue and a couple secrets. 

Play it at: https://taxiderby.itch.io/moment-to-midnight 

Moment to Midnight was made by: 

Story, Characters, Programming • @taxiderby https://twitter.com/taxiderby 
Environments, Programming • @daisyowl https://twitter.com/daisyowl 
Music, Audio • @cherof https://twitter.com/cherof

Soundtrack:
Bandcamp: https://cherof.bandcamp.com/album/moment-to-midnight-ost
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/album/1zCWoowuJiToYRevqHy79L
Apple Music: https://music.apple.com/us/album/moment-to-midnight-original-soundtrack-ep/1557126764
